decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission.

Reason: In order to comply with the provisions of Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:

CGL-Z1-XX-DR-A-PL0001; Environmental Noise Survey and Plant Noise Assessment Report ref.  31336/PNA2/Rev3 dated 5th August 2025 prepared by Hann Tucker Associates; Overheating Assessment ref. PP2437/MS/O/202507-AV dated July 2025 prepared by NRG Consulting; CGL-Z1-XX-DR-A-PL1013; CGL-Z1-01-DR-A-PL1003; CGL-Z1-03-DR-A-PL1004; CGL-Z1-R1-DR-A-PL1005; CGL-Z1-XX-DR-A-PL1042; CGL-Z1-XX-DR-A-PL1042; CGL-Z1-01-DR-A-PL1103; CGL-Z1-03-DR-A-PL1104; CGL-Z1-R1-DR-A-PL1105 Rev.P01; CGL-Z1-XX-DR-A-PL1113 Rev.P01; CGL-Z1-XX-DR-A-PL1114 Rev.P01; CGL-Z1-XX-DR-A-PL1114 Rev.P01; Daylight & Sunlight letter report ref. LB/23053 dated 26/09/2025 prepared by GIA.

Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interest of proper planning.
Condition : 3 - All new external work shall be carried out in materials that resemble, as closely as possible, in colour and texture those of the existing building, unless otherwise specified in the approved application. The proposed acoustic enclosure, ductwork and access ladder shown on the plans and elevations shall be painted slate grey.

Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area in accordance with the requirements of policy D1 and D2 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017. 
Condition : 4 - The external noise level emitted from plant, machinery or equipment at the development with specified noise mitigation hereby approved shall be lower than the typical existing background noise level by at least 10dBA, by 15dBA where the source is tonal, as assessed according to BS4142:2014 at the nearest and/or most affected noise sensitive premises, with machinery operating at maximum capacity and thereafter be permanently retained.

Reason: To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of the development site/ sur-rounding premises is not adversely affected by noise from mechanical installa-tions/ equipment in accordance with the requirements of policies A1 and A4 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017
Condition : 5 - Prior to use, machinery, plant or equipment at the development shall be mounted with proprietary anti-vibration isolators and fan motors shall be vibration isolated from the casing and adequately silenced and maintained as such. 

Reason: To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of the development site and surrounding premises is not adversely affected by vibration in accordance with the requirements of policies A1 and A4 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017
description: Installation of 1 x extract duct, 1 x supply air duct, access ladder, and 1 x access hatch within the rear lightwell, and 3 x condenser units within an acoustic enclosure at roof level.
